## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 190 retinal image captures during March 2019. This activity provides the basis for the month’s image-quality and grading results. The capture total represents the images submitted for review during the reporting period. The site’s activity was recorded for routine operational monitoring, with outcomes considered alongside the quality of the submitted images and the time taken to complete grading.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 6 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.2 per cent. Images classified as ungradable could not be assessed for grading purposes. The result is reported to support ongoing monitoring of image capture and review processes at Central Eye Clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 33 referable results during March 2019. The median lag from image capture to completion of grading was 7 days. These results provide the main activity indicators for the reporting period and should be considered together with the ungradable findings. The median lag reflects the midpoint of the recorded time between capture and grading, rather than the time taken for any individual image.
